evals.expected_output: Grounded AWS DMS CDC configuration (`BinaryLogging` `binlog_format=ROW` / PostgreSQL `rds.logical_replication=1`, S3 endpoint settings `DataFormat=parquet;cdcInsertsAndUpdates=true;IncludeOpForFullLoad=true;TimestampColumnName=dms_commit_ts;`), downstream `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pk ORDER BY dms_commit_ts DESC) = 1` + Iceberg `MERGE INTO` (`WHEN MATCHED AND op = 'D' THEN DELETE ...`), and CloudWatch alarms on `CDCLatencyTarget` + PostgreSQL `OldestReplicationSlotLag` / `max_slot_wal_keep_size`.
